The problem

A sign cannot physically stop a camera.

Sensitive people, operations, documents, screens, designs, prototypes and security layouts can be captured silently and shared instantly. Veil adds a practical enforcement layer.

01

Physical control

Magnetic-locking smartphone pouch issued at entry. The visitor keeps possession of the device.

02

Access zoning

Red, Amber and Green zones make device rules visible, understandable and operational.

03

Operational system

Signage, confidentiality reminders, device registration, staff SOPs and supervised exceptions.

How it works

Six steps. One controlled visitor journey.

01 IssueVisitor receives pouch.
02 InsertPhone goes inside.
03 LockStaff secures pouch.
04 EnterCamera access blocked.
05 ControlExceptions supervised.
06 ExitAuthorized unlocking.
Security zoning

Different spaces. Different device rules.

Red ZoneNo camera access. Phones secured in Veil pouches.
Amber ZoneOnly registered or specifically approved devices permitted.
Green ZoneNormal phone access for lobbies, outdoor areas and general circulation.
Deployment models

Built around the sensitivity of the site.

A

Full Lock

Phone remains locked throughout the visit. Intended for highly sensitive zones.

B

Controlled Unlock

Unlock permitted only in designated, supervised phone-use areas.

C

Event Deployment

Temporary use for VIP visits, confidential launches, audits and special events.
